content: MK's note, citing Virani: Qasim-i Anvar, Ibn Turka's charismatic associate from his Cairo days, was apparently claimed by Ismaʿilis; he was exiled from Herat in 1427 along with Ibn Turka for such suspect connections, though his putative connection with the Hurufis supplied the official excuse.
refers_to_primary: Virani, The Ismailis in the Middle Ages, 103-4
